notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I don't have any notes for you yet.

My first step was to open several commentary pages at once: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary, Wesley's Notes and the NET Bible notes for Proverbs 15. That went over the tool's usage limit. When I tried to open just the Enduring Word page, I was told I had no tool uses left for this turn. I didn't read any page, so I have nothing sourced to report. Your rules say not to fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written any verse notes or URLs.

If you send the request again, I'll open the pages one or two at a time. I'll start with the verse-by-verse sources:
- enduringword.com/bible-commentary/proverbs-15/
- the Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit and Wesley commentaries for Proverbs 15 on biblehub.com
- preceptaustin.org
- the netbible.org notes

Then I'll look for pages from each tradition and other views on the verses most likely to differ, such as v. 8 and v. 29 on the prayers of the wicked and the upright, v. 11 on Sheol and Abaddon, v. 24, and v. 33. I'll also check for prosperity-teaching readings of v. 6 and v. 16. If the limit still stops me partway, I'll give you notes for the verses I've covered and say which ones are missing.
